name: Sodium Valproate
mechanism: Increases GABA levels, blocks voltage-gated sodium channels
dosing: Epilepsy: start 600mg daily in divided doses, usual 1-2g daily. Bipolar: 750mg-2g daily
contraindications: Pregnancy (teratogenic), liver disease, urea cycle disorders, mitochondrial disorders
interactions: Lamotrigine (↑ levels), carbamazepine (enzyme induction), aspirin (↑ valproate)
monitoring: LFTs, FBC (baseline and early), weight, pregnancy prevention programme for women
pregnancy: CONTRAINDICATED - high teratogenicity and neurodevelopmental effects. Pregnancy Prevention Programme mandatory
sideEffects: Weight gain, tremor, hair loss, hepatotoxicity, pancreatitis, thrombocytopenia
pharmacokinetics: Highly protein bound, hepatic metabolism, half-life 9-18h
clinicalPearls: Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme essential for women of childbearing potential. Annual risk acknowledgement form. Contraception mandatory
indication: Epilepsy (generalised seizures), bipolar disorder, migraine prophylaxis (not in women of childbearing potential)
